durability.reason: No audit durability attempt was made for the committed business row.

semantic.reason: Refusing after commit establishes no atomicity.

outage.reason: The binding retains no durable record for downstream deferral.

retry.reason: Bounded quiet observation plus source inspection: no retry scheduler; caller retries run the pipeline again.

semantic.reason: claimsAtLeastOnce is not supplied by the binding alone.

idempotency.reason: Pair-key dedupe is in-memory per instance, not across restarts.

semantic.reason: Downstream deduplication/durability is outside this binding.

business_failure_posture.reason: failsClosedBeforeCommit does not describe this failed_closed result after the commit gate ran.

retry.reason: Permanent and retryable failures collapse to the same binding code.

semantic.reason: No acknowledgment after the commit; the declaration alone supplies no delivery guarantee.

backpressure.reason: Gate ordering exists, but no backlog alert after commit is exposed.

shutdown.reason: No shutdown/flush surface or durable backlog on this binding.
